title: wsutil: Optimize utf_8_validate a bit
description:
Remove decrements of length and check against the pointer reaching
the end. Don't check against the out pointer, because the extra
dereference is slower. (The compiler probably optimizes the latter
bit on higher optimization levels if we do check against the out
pointer, though.)
